column1: # THE PRODUCERS AND THE SUBJECT DIGESTS THEY PRODUCE.

# --- THE PRODUCTION SUBJECT, AS THE BUILD GRAPH PRODUCES IT ---
# The three producers are THREE DIFFERENT COMPILER BINARIES with THREE
# DIFFERENT DIGESTS. They compile the SAME source and produce a
# BYTE-IDENTICAL subject object. That byte-identity is the obligation
# FROZEN-01 discharges; it is NOT a claim that a C-compiled object and
# a PolyC-compiled object are byte-identical, which is false and is
# --- THE C ORACLE, WHICH IS A DIFFERENT KIND OF PRODUCER ---

column2: YES (the three PolyC subjects and the production subject are one digest; the C oracle is a different digest)
